name: @atlasbound/handoff
description: One note per branch that lets a fresh session continue: built from measured facts, with the person's own decisions and jobs kept.

verbs.what: rebuild this branch's note from measured facts, then show it with this session's messages and the fill-in
the JSON on standard input: write now, next and the kept lines into the note; a kept line names the message it comes from
the note of this branch as stored, with its age and whether HEAD moved since
<n> [new words]: you drop kept line n, or reword it when new words follow; you type its phrase at a plain terminal, never an AI session
why each kept line is there, what was dropped, the note's HEAD against the live one, what was not measured, the context notice
